scope: Original code roles composed using this language glossary. Modern proposals, not historically attested compounds. No related-language fallback or opaque collision suffix.
naming_principles: German noun compounds and object-before-operation identifiers; source roles disambiguate hardware, execution and file persistence.

verified_lexeme_history.history: Middle High German spīcher and Old High German spīhhāri, borrowed from Late Latin spicarium (grain store), from Latin spica (ear of grain).
verified_lexeme_history.project_use: The storage metaphor motivates memory and storage roles; new code compounds are modern proposals.

rationale.x86: Processor architecture name retained intact; x is not a horizontal-coordinate variable in these roles.
rationale.흐름여부: Boolean indicating whether a network receiver is an input/output stream, distinct from java.util.stream.Stream.
rationale.OpenJDK-소스빌드와-자체커널-이식: OpenJDK is a proper project name. Port here means adapting software to a kernel, not a network socket port.
